title: On two conjectures for generalized off-diagonal Schur numbers
summary: For an integer $t \geq 3$, let $\mathcal{L}(t)$ denote the linear equation $x_1 + x_2 + \cdots + x_{t-1} = x_t,$ where all variables are positive integers. For integers $k \geq 1$ and $t_0,t_1,\dots,t_{k-1} \geq 3$, the generalized Schur number $S(k;t_0,t_1,\dots,t_{k-1})$ is the least positive integer $N$ such that every $k$-coloring of $[1,N]$, for some $i \in \{0,1,\dots,k-1\}$, a solution to $\mathcal{L}(t_i)$ with all variables monochromatic in color $i$.
